_comment: Priority 3: Example outputs demonstrating type-specific analysis. Each example shows a finding that only fires because the clause was correctly classified and the type-specific extraction branch ran.

examples.scenario: Late payment interest added (type-specific: only extracted for PAYMENT clauses)
examples.title: [Value Change] Late Payment Interest: not specified → 18.0%
examples.description: [Clause Type: payment] Late Payment Interest was not specified in the baseline but is now set to '18.0%'. Review whether this new value is acceptable.

examples.scenario: SLA response time extended: 2h → 8h (type-specific: RESPONSE_TIME_HOURS only for SLA clauses)
examples.title: [Value Change] SLA Response Time: 2.0 hours → 8.0 hours
examples.description: [Clause Type: sla] SLA Response Time changed from 2.0 hours to 8.0 hours. This is unfavourable — a higher value increases risk or cost for the client.

value_change.label: SLA Response Time
value_change.evidence: SLA Response Time: baseline=2.0 hours, new=8.0 hours, delta=+6.0 (+300%)

examples.scenario: Warranty period extracted from months (type-specific: WARRANTY months→days conversion)
examples.title: [Value Change] Warranty Period: 90 days → 30 days
examples.description: [Clause Type: warranty] Template stated '90 days' warranty; vendor draft states '1 month' (converted to 30 days). This is unfavourable — a lower value weakens client protection.

value_change.label: Warranty Period
value_change.evidence: Warranty Period: baseline=90 days, new=30 days, delta=-60.0 (-67%)

examples.scenario: Non-compete duration detected and compared (type-specific: NON_COMPETE clause)
examples.title: [Value Change] Non-Compete Duration: 12 months → 36 months
examples.description: [Clause Type: non_compete] Non-Compete Duration changed from 12 months to 36 months. This is unfavourable — a higher value increases risk or cost for the client.

value_change.label: Non-Compete Duration
value_change.evidence: Non-Compete Duration: baseline=12 months, new=36 months, delta=+24.0 (+200%)

examples.scenario: Data retention period extended from months to days (type-specific: months→days conversion)
examples.title: [Value Change] Data Retention: 30 days → 180 days
examples.description: [Clause Type: data_retention] Template specified 30 days data retention. Vendor draft specifies 6 months (180 days). Review against DPDP Act storage limitation obligations.

examples.scenario: Assignment consent requirement added (type-specific: ASSIGNMENT categorical extraction)
examples.title: [Value Change] Assignment Consent: not_required → required
examples.description: [Clause Type: assignment] Assignment Consent changed from 'not_required' to 'required'. This is a material legal change requiring review.

examples.scenario: Arbitration seat specified for the first time (type-specific: JURISDICTION arbitration seat)
examples.title: [Value Change] Arbitration Seat: mumbai → singapore
examples.description: [Clause Type: jurisdiction] Arbitration Seat changed from 'mumbai' to 'singapore'. This is a material legal change requiring review. Offshore arbitration substantially increases cost.

examples.scenario: Audit frequency reduced from annual to every 3 years (type-specific: AUDIT_RIGHTS)
examples.title: [Value Change] Audit Frequency: 12 months → 36 months
examples.description: [Clause Type: audit_rights] Audit Frequency changed from 12 months to 36 months. Review whether this reduces meaningful oversight.

examples.scenario: Service credit percentage halved (type-specific: SERVICE_CREDITS clause)
examples.title: [Value Change] Service Credit: 10.0% → 2.0%
examples.description: [Clause Type: service_credits] Service Credit changed from 10.0% to 2.0%. This is unfavourable — a lower value weakens client protection.

examples.scenario: Insurance amount increased (type-specific: INSURANCE monetary extraction)
examples.title: [Value Change] Insurance Requirement: ₹1.00 Cr → ₹5.00 Cr
examples.description: [Clause Type: insurance] Insurance Requirement changed from ₹1.00 Cr to ₹5.00 Cr. This is favourable — a higher value strengthens client protection.
